entry.title: H99 Papas Fritas — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, cola, dark rum or bourbon
Occasion: Compact premium Liga session, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Black pepper, earth, cocoa, cedar, espresso and a touch of sweet spice put the H99 Papas Fritas squarely in the dark Liga family. The 4½″ × 44 format gives more tobacco and a slower read than a coronet while keeping the commitment to one cigar, making it the cleanest low-cost test of whether the H99 profile belongs in the catalogue.
entry.noteHtml: The Index lists the exact 4½″ × 44 single at A$30.70.
